title: 1997 contact: 10,000 people paid $10 million each
summary: Steven Greer tells of 1997 contact: 10,000 people paid $10 million each, about 1997 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: who said, "We have given at least 10,000 people $10 million each or more to secure their cooperation with what we're doing."

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, says that in Washington in 1997 a contact told him that at least 10,000 people had each been paid $10 million or more to secure their cooperation with a secret effort. If true, it would mean silence about the subject had been bought on a huge scale.
